text: With Unity Catalog governance chosen as the stack, we're whiteboarding the medallion layers for Harborview's actual claims data -- before creating a single schema.
Four tables: claims_raw lands the nightly drops untouched, claims_clean validates them, and gold forks into two very different tables with two very different audiences.
The rule that scopes everything else: a table only needs row filters and column masks if a single row can be tied back to a named patient.
claims_summary_gold aggregates away any patient identity by construction. claims_detail_gold keeps patient_name and patient_ssn, so it inherits the real risk.
That fork is settled. Next: designing exactly who gets to see a patient's name, and who sees NULL.
